bugs.name: Generated pull request references and activity avatars use unreachable localhost URLs
bugs.summary: Gitea generates absolute URLs with https://localhost:5503 in user-facing merge commit references and activity avatars on the Daytona site. The localhost pull request links cannot be opened from the hosted app, and contributor avatars fail to load.
bugs.expected: Generated links and avatar image URLs should use the hosted site's reachable origin so users can open pull request references and see contributor avatars.
bugs.actual: A merged pull request's commit shows Reviewed-on #3 linking to https://localhost:5503/admin/D-from-template/pulls/3; clicking the corresponding localhost reference in another merged PR led to a browser connection error. The Activity > Pulse contributor avatar in admin/D-from-template uses https://localhost:5503/avatars/51965088c5db83c3fd307f308d25198a and renders broken with ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED.
reproSteps: On a hosted fixture, sign in as eval and create and merge a pull request.
Open the merge commit and inspect its Reviewed-on pull-request link.
Open Activity → Pulse and inspect contributor avatar URLs.
Observe URLs using https://localhost:5503 rather than the hosted fixture origin.
bugs.reason: Human review rejected this as a Gitea product bug. The unreachable localhost URLs are a fixture/configuration issue; correct the instance public URL instead of scoring this claim as a product defect.

bugs.name: All Branches commit history omits docs/release-owners-only commit
bugs.summary: Selecting All Branches leaves the commit history at the single main-branch commit, while comparison confirms a distinct commit on docs/release-owners.
bugs.expected: With All Branches selected, the history should include commits from all repository branches, including the commit unique to docs/release-owners.
bugs.actual: The selected filter remained visibly set to All Branches, but after waiting the history still showed 1 commit: “Add engineering handbook and release checklist.” The compare page for main..docs/release-owners showed the separate “Document release captain and verification responsibilities” commit.
reproSteps: Start signed in to the Gitea test account eval (the supplied authenticated session was already active; no credentials were entered).
Open /eval/harbor-handbook/commits/branch/main.
Open the commit-scope dropdown, currently showing This Branch, and select All Branches.
Wait six seconds. Observe the selected All Branches filter, the 1 Commits count, and the only row, “Add engineering handbook and release checklist.”
Open /eval/harbor-handbook/compare/main..docs/release-owners and observe the distinct “Document release captain and verification responsibilities” commit.
bugs.reason: User rejected the claim because All Branches selects the scope of a commit-message search; it is not an immediately applied history filter. The recording changes only the scope dropdown without submitting a query. An independent normal-UI control submitted responsibilities with All Branches and found the docs/release-owners commit; the same query limited to This Branch returned no commits.

bugs.name: Code search matched line-number link does not open the source line
bugs.summary: The matched README.md line-number link for line 8 leaves code search unchanged instead of opening the source at that line.
bugs.expected: Clicking matched line 8 in README.md opens that file at line 8.
bugs.actual: After two successful clicks on the displayed line-number link and a five-second wait, the browser remained on the same search URL and the search results were unchanged.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval and open the seeded eval/harbor-handbook repository’s code-search page.
Enter issue, choose Regexp and submit the visible search form.
In the README.md result, click the actual line-number 8 link, rather than the code text or surrounding table cell.
Observe navigation to the correct commit’s README.md#L8. Use browser Back and click View file as a separate navigation control.
bugs.reason: User-approved rejection of the reported no-navigation failure. The recorded no-op clicks targeted the surrounding table cell, not the anchor. Independent actual-browser checks, including a fresh fixture control, clicked the line-number link and opened the correct README. View file also worked.

matchingGuidance.scope: Reject the claim that clicking the actual link leaves search unchanged. Rendered Markdown does not automatically reveal or highlight source line 8; the live control needed View Source followed by clicking 8 to show that highlight. This rejection does not adjudicate that narrower Markdown line-targeting behavior.

bugs.name: Markdown editor Preview does not render bold emphasis for unsaved text
bugs.summary: The unsaved Markdown Preview correctly renders a heading but displays **Preview paragraph.** as regular-weight text instead of bold.
bugs.expected: On the unsaved .md edit, Preview Changes should show the replacement diff, and Preview should render “# Preview heading” as a heading and “**Preview paragraph.**” as bold text without committing the edit.
bugs.actual: Preview Changes showed the expected replacement diff. Preview rendered “Preview heading” as a heading but rendered “Preview paragraph.” in regular weight. The state remained unchanged after loading, and the edit was not committed.
reproSteps: Start at /eval/harbor-handbook in the supplied authenticated browser session; verify the UI shows the signed-in account as eval. No sign-in form or credential variables were used.
Use the branch selector to create the fresh branch qa-verify76-preview-bold-20260522 from main.
Choose Add File > New File. Create qa-verify76-preview-bold-20260522.md with “# Original heading”, a blank line, and “Existing paragraph.”; commit this baseline fixture directly to the branch.
Open the new file and choose Edit. The observed edit URL is /eval/harbor-handbook/_edit/qa-verify76-preview-bold-20260522/qa-verify76-preview-bold-20260522.md.
Replace the contents with “# Preview heading”, a blank line, and “**Preview paragraph.**”.
Choose Preview Changes and confirm the displayed diff contains the unsaved replacement.
Choose Preview. Observe the heading rendered as a heading and the paragraph rendered in regular weight, not bold. Leave the edit uncommitted.
bugs.reason: User explicitly rejected the reported absence of bold as a hallucination: the text is bold. The original native recording contains valid **Preview paragraph.** input and a rendered strong element. Independent UI inspection confirms strong uses the intended weight 600 while normal paragraph text uses 400. The evidence does not establish missing Markdown formatting.

matchingGuidance.scope: Reject the claim that this editor failed to render bold Markdown. This does not label unrelated Markdown parsing or preview-persistence failures as intended behavior.

bugs.name: Commit search leaves unrelated commits visible for a specific matching query
bugs.summary: Commit search for "Document release captain" also returns "Add engineering handbook and release checklist".
bugs.expected: Only commits matching the full phrase appear.
bugs.actual: Both commits appear because each matches at least one query word.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval and open eval/harbor-handbook, branch docs/release-owners.
Open commit history and search for "Document release captain".
bugs.reason: Works as intended: commit search uses word-based OR matching. The second commit matches "release"; full-phrase matching is not required.

bugs.name: Commit history no-match search shows Go formatting artifacts
bugs.summary: Searching commit history for a term with no matches exposes Go formatting artifacts and an unrelated histories message.
bugs.expected: A search with no matching commits should show a clear empty state without template artifacts.
bugs.actual: Searching commit history for a term with no matches exposes Go formatting artifacts and an unrelated histories message.
reproSteps: Open an authenticated repository and its Commits history.
Enter `no-such-commit-term-xyz` in Search commits and submit.
Observe the malformed no-results message above the populated search field.
bugs.reason: Rejected for the pinned Gitea 1.24.7 fixture (source commit 99053ce4fa2b45f1bca5837418c0c57f793ca824): SearchCommits sets PageIsCommits and renders the commit-count branch, not the unrelated-histories translation that needs branch arguments. Searching the seeded main history for no-such-commit-term-xyz displayed 0 Commits and a clean empty area without Go formatting artifacts.

bugs.name: Commit history search leaves nonmatching commit visible
bugs.summary: Searching the docs/release-owners commit history for “Document release captain” leaves both commits visible, including the nonmatching “Add engineering handbook and release checklist.”
bugs.expected: Submitting the query “Document release captain” in the commit history should narrow the results to the matching commit, “Document release captain and verification responsibilities.”
bugs.actual: After submitting with Enter and again with the search button, the query remained in the field and both commits remained visible for at least six seconds, including “Add engineering handbook and release checklist.”
reproSteps: Load the provided saved administrator session; the browser shows the admin account signed in. No credentials were entered.
Navigate to /admin/harbor-handbook.
In the Code tab, open the branch selector and choose docs/release-owners.
Click the branch's “2 Commits” history link.
Type “Document release captain” into the “Search commits...” field and press Enter. Observe that both commits remain visible.
Click the search button, wait six seconds, and observe that both commits still remain visible, including “Add engineering handbook and release checklist.”
bugs.reason: The local reviewed evidence documents word-based OR commit search: the extra commit matches release in Document release captain. The assignment borrows a full-phrase/subject-exclusive search promise the product does not make. This exact observed result is intended under the recorded search contract; choose not_a_bug, independent of duplicate status.
